[[AS Saint-Étienne]] won '''Division 1 season 1963/1964''' of the [[Ligue de Football Professionnel|French Association Football League]] with 44 points.

Promoted from [[1963–64 French Division 2|Division 2]], who will play in [[1964–65 French Division 1|Division 1 season 1964/1965]]
* [[Lille OSC]]: Champion
* [[FC Sochaux-Montbéliard]]: runner-up
* [[Sporting Toulon Var|SC Toulon]]: Fourth place ([[FC Metz]] (3rd) did not qualify)
